challenge.method: Compared the closely worded UK BY-SA text and the Index’s French NC-SA 2.0 row. Checked whether jurisdiction came from the publisher heading itself or solely from an identifier.
challenge.results: The UK NC-SA heading explicitly says England and Wales. Section 1(e) lists Non-Commercial, §1(f) defines it and §2.1 repeats it. The French row has a different entity, French title and digest. Its title omits jurisdiction, as do the NL and JP titles recorded in the decision. Those labels cannot be supplied from an SPDX suffix.

limitations: The legal-code heading supplies the instrument name. The site footer concerns site content, and the publisher’s separate notice concerns license text. Neither determines the license of any project file.
Active describes the Index’s editorial decision. Legal effect, currency, deprecation and publication remain separate.
